internal.title: Incident Report: Elevated Error Rates in Checkout Service
internal.body:
At 12:03 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered due to a high error rate in the checkout service. Initial diagnosis identified error injection in the checkout service as the primary hypothesis, supported by elevated error ratios. Subsequent diagnosis rounds considered frontend service errors but found inconclusive evidence for latency issues. Multiple proposals for remediation were reviewed but initially refused due to target mismatches and missing dry run validations. The incident was escalated for further investigation. Recovery actions and final resolution details are pending further updates.

Timeline highlights:
- 12:03:50: Alert received for high error rate in checkout
- 12:23:32: Diagnosis round 1 identified checkout error injection
- 12:23:39: Proposal refused due to target mismatch
- 12:23:41: Replanned diagnosis
- 12:23:52: Diagnosis round 3 revisited checkout error injection
- 12:23:56: Proposal refused due to missing dry run

Current status: Incident escalated for deeper analysis and resolution.

external.body: Between 12:03 and 12:24 UTC on November 8, 2026, some customers experienced errors when attempting to complete checkout. Our engineering team identified elevated error rates in the checkout service and is actively investigating the root cause. We are working to resolve the issue as quickly as possible and will provide updates as they become available. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
